annotations.title: Move an app to a group

description: Put one app in a group, or in none (group: "none"). Tell the owner: this changes its section on Home, the alert rules it follows and which agents see it. Only for connections that see every app. Making or editing groups is app-only. Needs write access.

app.description: The app: its slug, name, domain (shop.app), URL or id. list_apps shows them all.

group.description: The group's slug or name (list_groups shows them), or "none" to take the app out of its group

name: set_app_group
title: Move an app to a group
